doc: The NEUTRAL OBSERVATION the decision server reads: one plain object per game per seat, integers and booleans only. Every `seat` group is an object keyed by its field names in the order listed; after them, `cities` is a list with one object per LIVING city of the seat, in the seat's city-ARRAY order (TS `seat.cities`: founding order, a lost city spliced out, a gained one appended), each keyed by the `city` fields in the order listed. Field kinds: bool = a flag; int = a plain integer (a table index, a tile index, a count, a price); city = one of THIS seat's living cities named by its CENTRE tile, -1 where none; list = a list of plain integers, laid out as its meaning says (a dense list indexed by a table index, or ascending indices); table = a list of fixed-width rows of plain integers, ascending. Every price is an exact integer: no field carries a fraction. Emitters: gpu/core/neutral.py (GPU).

buy: the city holding the cheapest completable gold-buyable building
the treasury clears its price plus the peace-gold reserve
a gold settler buy is affordable and the spawn city has the pop
a gold military unit buy is open (under 2x cities, a candidate type)
a gold tile buy is open
Monumentality: a faith builder buy is open
Monumentality: a faith settler buy is open
where a bought unit spawns: the capital, else the first living city
a faith worship-building buy is open
a faith missionary buy is open
a faith apostle buy is open
a faith inquisitor buy is open
a faith warrior monk buy is open
a levy is open and the seat is at war with a major
a faith naturalist buy is open
a faith rock band buy is open
a faith class-building buy is open (Valletta)
the building's table index, -1 where none
a faith land combat unit buy is open
the unit type index, -1 where none
a faith Great Person patronage is open
a gold Great Person patronage is open
a gold district buy is open
a faith district buy is open
route: the origin city of the trade route this seat would open
its destination: a CENTRE tile, or -(2 + city-state index); -1 where none
nuke: the WMD device index a silo would launch, -1 where none
research: per tech table index: its effective research cost (`effectiveResearchCostIn`: the base cost, boosted and js-rounded — a whole number), -1 where the tech is not open (`availableTechsIn`)
per civic table index: the same for civics (`availableCivicsIn`)
policy: the policy card table indices this seat may slot now (`unlockedPolicyIds`), ascending; empty without a government
the adopted government's slots by kind (`fitPolicies`' governmentSlots, wonder extras included): [military, economic, diplomatic, wildcard]; all 0 without a government
war: the war head's width (`warTargets`): every other major in ascending seat order, then the whole city-state roster in index order; a war COLUMN below is a position in that list
the target columns this seat may declare war on now, ascending
the target columns it may sue for peace with now, ascending

per MAJOR target column (the war head's leading columns, one per other major): the war kind a declaration there takes by default (`defaultWarKind`: the cheapest casus belli held), -1 where none is held or the column is not in `declare`
per MAJOR target column: the leader's own buffed kind where it is allowed (`WAR_BUFF_ROWS`), else the default; -1 likewise
envoy: per city-state index (the roster index, fixed for the game): the envoys this seat holds there, -1 where it has not met the city-state or the city-state is gone
congress: the two resolution table indices (CONGRESS_RESOLUTIONS) on the ANNOUNCED slate of the Regular Session the coming turn would hold (TS `worldCongress`: every CONGRESS_INTERVAL turn from CONGRESS_MIN_ERA; the slate is `state.congressSlate`), -1 in a slot with no resolution or on a turn with no session
per slate slot: the outcome this seat prefers on that resolution (`preference`), -1 where the slot is -1
per slate slot: the target it prefers (`preference`), -1 where the slot is -1
that session also holds the Diplomatic Victory resolution (world era >= CONGRESS_DV_MIN_ERA)

the Diplomatic Victory leader's major seat index when `dv`: the most diplomatic victory points among majors holding a city, ties to the lower index (the scan inside TS `runDvResolution`); -1 otherwise
a Special Session would sit on the coming turn: a called emergency whose hiatus has run out, the Congress open (TS `specialSessions`)
the favor price step of one extra vote (`buyVotes`' curve)
gp: per Great Person class: the individual on offer (`gpOffer`: a roster index, -1 a draw pending, -2 exhausted); empty where the world has no Great Person classes
per class: the major seat index that passed on the standing offer (`gpPassedBy`), -1 nobody
per class: the offer's frozen price in Great Person points (a whole number)
per class: this seat's Great Person points, floored

city: the city's CENTRE tile, its name on the wire
the settlers on order in its queue, at any depth
the production columns it may queue now (the one production layout, cpu/core/prodLayout.ts), ascending; empty while its queue has no room

for every OPEN district column: each plot the district may go on, as [column, tile, adjacency] — the adjacency the district would earn there (floored; 0 for the types with no adjacency yield) — ascending by column, then tile
per district table index: the specialist slots the district offers (`citySpecialistSlots`); empty where the world has no districts
per district table index: the citizens pinned into its slots (`City.specialistPref`), -1 where the automatic rule fills it; empty likewise
every plot the city may work (`workableTiles`), as [tile, resource priority, locked]: the plot's resource priority (0 = none) and 1 where its citizen pin is set (`Tile.locked`); ascending by tile

every plot a sibling city holds that this city may claim (`swapTileOk`), as [tile, the holder's centre, worked, locked]: worked = 1 where any of the seat's cities works it, locked = 1 where its pin is set; ascending by tile
